simple.meaning: אׇמְנָם (ʼomnâm) is a Hebrew word meaning “verily.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אׇמְנָם (H551) appears 9 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ruth 3:12, with occurrences in Ruth, 2 Kings, Job, Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אׇמְנָם (H551) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אׇמְנָם (H551) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אׇמְנָם (ʼomnâm) / H551 is traced through Ruth 3:12, 2 Kings 19:17, Job 9:2, Job 12:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

timeline.evidenceText: Now it is true that I am a near kinsman. However, there is a kinsman nearer than I.
Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have laid waste the nations and their lands,
“Truly I know that it is so,
“No doubt, but you are the people,
If it is true that I have erred,
If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me,
Yes surely, God will not do wickedly,
For truly my words are not false.
Truly, Yahweh, the kings of Assyria have destroyed all the countries and their land,
